timeline.summary: Prahv, seat of Azorius power, is destroyed when the Parhelion collides with it.
timeline.quote: In Dissension , Prahv was destroyed when the Parhelion , fortress-ship of the Boros angels, collided with it.

citation.text: "Azorius Senate", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szadek is arrested by Agrus Kos and imprisoned by the Azorius, who secretly execute him.
timeline.quote: imprisoned by the Azorius who secretly executes him

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ghut Rak finds a good use for an Azorius courthouse.
timeline.quote: Finally, a good use for an Azorius courthouse.

citation.text: Weight of Spires (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig proposes pitting Razia and the Azorius sky marshals in a bidding war to fund Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: We could create a fine bidding war—enough to fund the final stages of Project Kraj.

citation.text: Assault Zeppelid (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Parhelion reappears on a collision course with Prahv as the Azorius, Boros and Selesnya become embroiled in a scandal over Feather, who turned herself in.
timeline.quote: The Dissension began with the dramatic reappearance of the Parhelion

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the senate chamber of Grand Arbiter Augustin IV, Modar Bejiri advances to receive his field hussar's brooch.
timeline.quote: Modar Bejiri advanced to receive his field hussar's brooch

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The district imperator clasps the field hussar's brooch on Modar's cloak, completing his promotion.
timeline.quote: The district imperator unbuckled Modar's old signet brooch and clasped the field hussar's brooch in its place on his cloak.

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The district imperator denies an arrest request because the Guildpact forbids direct action against a guild member without a warrant.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact prohibits direct action against the member of a guild, without a documented warrant signed by the presiding senators.

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Four". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Modar requests an emergency writ of arrest for himself, handing over his brooch as the relic of authority.
timeline.quote: Modar handed him the field hussar's brooch.

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Four". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An Azorius arrest team led by the district imperator tears the tent apart as Modar pulls the shapeshifter's claws into his chest while it takes his form.
timeline.quote: as the shapeshifter's bones began to rearrange themselves into the anatomy of a vedalken knight

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Six". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the mess hall Krenko overhears Boros soldiers saying the guild's succession has come down to a duel, found by the Azorius in the fine print.
timeline.quote: "No, the nosy Azorius found it in the fine print," he said.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: The original Prahv is demolished when the Boros warship Parhelion crashes into it.
timeline.quote: The original Prahv, the so-called Spires of Order, was demolished when the Boros warship Parhelion crashed into it.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3", section "New Prahv, the Azorius Guildhall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isperia is convinced to lead the Azorius as crime and chaos grow without the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Isperia decided her service was needed enough to trump her preferences.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3", section "Supreme Judge Isperia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Azorius revive the trias politica of three Columns after the Guildpact dissolves and Prahv is rebuilt.
timeline.quote: the Azorius revivified the concept, and it has become deeply meaningful and reflective of the guild's structure and hierarchy.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3", section "The Three Columns". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: New Prahv is built once popular support grows and Isperia accepts leadership of the guild.
timeline.quote: Only once popular support built up and Isperia accepted the leadership of the guild did the gears of reconstruction begin to turn.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3", section "New Prahv, the Azorius Guildhall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Boros built a prison in the sky out of the reach of Azorius statutes.
timeline.quote: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

citation.text: Angelic Edict (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aurelia shows Gideon the contested Ninth on her war table and explains how the guilds fight over it.
timeline.quote: The Rakdos and Gruul tug and tear it apart like a dromad's corpse

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia recounts that after the Guildpact broke the Azorius abandoned the Ninth and it was largely lost, under a disgraced earlier Boros leader.
timeline.quote: in the aftermath, the Azorius had to abandon the Ninth so they could rebuild New Prahv.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Symond is arrested by Azorius arresters over a body, and sees a cloaked Orzhov rider on a horse as he is taken away.
timeline.quote: Symond found himself being ushered away under the guard of a half dozen arresters.

citation.text: "Bilagru Will Come for You". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Symond kills a vedalken courier in the Azorius Tenth District so that arresters will take him into custody.
timeline.quote: I drew my sword and plunged it into his chest.

citation.text: "Bilagru Will Come for You". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: In his cell Symond finds an Orzhov coin and sees Lord Kazmyr at the window as chaos erupts among the guards.
timeline.quote: Lord Kazmyr was staring back at him.

citation.text: "Bilagru Will Come for You". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jace explains that the cornerstone is an Azorius waypoint on the Implicit Maze and that he must find them all.
timeline.quote: The cornerstone by your shop is actually an Azorius waypoint, an ancient series of clues left by the Azorius guildmages.

citation.text: "Barrin's Tall Tale". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Decades later Oana is an esteemed arbiter with thirty years of service.
timeline.quote: Arbiter Oana Vitellius I tucked her graying hair into her traditional judge's cowl and smiled at her reflection.

citation.text: "Expectations". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Vinni walks into the Lyev Column, announces herself as Lavinia and asks to become an arrester.
timeline.quote: "My name is Lavinia. I want to be an arrester."

citation.text: "The One Hundred Steps". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals influential Azorius Senate members were petrified while he was away.
timeline.quote: a few influential members in the Azorius Senate were...eliminated.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains a planeswalking gorgon assassin with a grudge against the Azorius swore she would return.
timeline.quote: About a year ago, there was a gorgon assassin operating on Ravnica.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace of the Azorius's mass arrest of Golgari and her brutal imprisonment, her escape and her wish to lead the Golgari.
timeline.quote: They assumed I was Golgari because I was a gorgon, and they arrested me too.

citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the door bears the Azorius symbol that appears when they try to planeswalk.
timeline.quote: It's the symbol of the Azorius.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Isperia gathers the guilds in a climate of suspicion to propose cooperation.
timeline.quote: Isperia gathered the guilds to propose a radical idea: cooperation.

citation.text: Guild Summit (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Krenko incites a riot at Sawtooth Prison, is transferred toward Udzec, and escapes to rejoin his gang.
timeline.quote: he was able to slip away to rendezvous with his gang

citation.text: "Krenko", section "In and out of prison". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet has Ral turn the project into a beacon to call planeswalkers against Bolas, an idea planted by Millena.
timeline.quote: he had Ral turn Project Lightning Bug into a beacon

citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug", section "Interplanar Beacon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Azorius Senate orders a mass arrest of Golgari and Vraska is imprisoned.
timeline.quote: issued a writ of mass arrest for any people caught bearing allegiance to the Golgari

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Persecuted". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag goes into Zita's effigy shop, is heckled by an Azorius elocutor outside, and clumsily tries to chat her up.
timeline.quote: I'd like to buy these.

citation.text: "The Illusions of Child's Play" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag performs poetry and a comedy set mocking Azorius and Dovin Baan, which falls flat when an arrester appears.
timeline.quote: I finish my set anyway—twenty-three minutes of pure torture.

citation.text: "The Illusions of Child's Play" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: On the way home Zita fixes graffiti insulting Dovin Baan, and an Azorius arrester arrests her for defacing a building and slandering a Grand Arbiter, with Kodolaag's statement logged against her.
timeline.quote: defacing a public building," he continues, "Plus Azorius code 6342-P, slandering a Grand Arbiter," the arrester says, binding Zita up

citation.text: "The Illusions of Child's Play" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Bolas takes Dovin in and offers him the chance to reshape a plane into flawless order, so Dovin takes over the Azorius Senate from within.
timeline.quote: Dovin emerged as the new head of the Lyev Column, replacing the unpopular hussar Agmand Sarv .

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Vraska kills Isperia, Dovin becomes Azorius guildmaster and introduces spy thopters and precognitive arrests.
timeline.quote: When Isperia was killed by Vraska , Dovin took over as guildmaster

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An Azorius soldier arrests Zita for graffiti modification.
timeline.quote: an Azorius soldier arrested Zita for a minor offense of graffiti modification.

citation.text: "Kodolaag", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A vedalken mugger steals one of Reza's satchels, and when Reza seeks help at the edge of the Thinktank, Azorius arresters suspect him instead.
timeline.quote: He swipes at the strap of one of my satchels. It comes free, and then he's running off with my precious reference texts.

citation.text: "The Ascension of Reza" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Missing his identity rune, Reza throws a vial of cleansing oil at the arresters and flees, fearing arrest under his own new law.
timeline.quote: I retrieve it from the satchel, then throw it down at the arrester's feet.

citation.text: "The Ascension of Reza" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: A huge electrical elemental emerges from a rift over the Thinktank workshop, and Azorius archons cannot act because of the jurisdiction dispute.
timeline.quote: More lightning lashes out of the rift as the elemental starts to take on a distinct form

citation.text: "The Ascension of Reza" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Azorius archons and nullmages subdue the elemental after Reza's law rune brings help.
timeline.quote: They work together to cast a blue dome of magic over the elemental

citation.text: "The Ascension of Reza" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Lavinia becomes acting guildmaster of the Azorius.
timeline.quote: She survived the War and became acting guildmaster of the Azorius.

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dovin Baan mandates lockets to track Senate personnel.
timeline.quote: Mandatory lockets enable the tracking of all Senate personnel for improved security and efficiency.

citation.text: Azorius Locket (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vraska rides a Realmbreaker branch down over Ravnica as general for Elesh Norn and has it plunge through the Azorius Senate.
timeline.quote: I choose the simplest one and order a branch to dive straight through its center.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Vraska at seventeen is held by an Azorius guard, and Ludmilla is killed while calling to her fellow Golgari prisoners.
timeline.quote: And then, with a wet slice and a heavy thump, she was not. I was the only gorgon left.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vraska has Phyrexian agents blind the Azorius and Boros guards, and orders the blinded forced to the Transguild Promenade as an example.
timeline.quote: "Lead them to the Transguild Promenade as an example of what we do to the unjust."

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Azorius senators set up verity circles to question all guests.
timeline.quote: They had cast their spells with admirable speed

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: The Agency and Azorius search the sealed crime scene.
timeline.quote: Barrier wards had been deployed inside the scene

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Azorius mages remove Etrata from Karlov Manor and no Dimir members intervene.
timeline.quote: Etrata's removal from the grounds of Karlov Manor took no time at all in the grand scheme of things.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Ezrim rebukes his investigators over Etrata's disappearance.
timeline.quote: Etrata is still missing.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft breaks a notorious assassin out of an Azorius holding cell.
timeline.quote: Proft had never been a by-the-book investigator, but even he never expected to find himself breaking a notorious assassin out of a maximum-security Azorius holding cell.

citation.text: Unauthorized Exit (Murders at Karlov Manor, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Etrata evades the Boros and Azorius but not Kaya.
timeline.quote: Etrata evaded the Boros arresters and Azorius lawmages, but not even a master assassin could give Kaya the slip.

citation.text: The Chase Is On (Murders at Karlov Manor, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kos's spirit is forced to serve as an Azorius Senate spirit guard, and Augustin IV brings him back to stop Szadek.
timeline.quote: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV brought him back for the sole purpose of stopping Szadek

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Parhelion, piloted by Szadek, crashes into the Azorius guildhall.
timeline.quote: piloted by Szadek, crashed into the Azorius guildhall

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the invasion, the Azorius are overwhelmed and outsource complicated cases to the Agency.
timeline.quote: the guild outsourced these cases to the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations

citation.text: "Azorius Senate", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Azorius Senate House hosted several of the transguilt meetings during the War of the Spark.
timeline.quote: Hosted several of the transguilt meetings during the War of the Spark .

citation.text: "Precinct Two", section "Neighborhoods and Landmarks". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Centuries before the Phyrexian Invasion, Ezrim breaks off from the Azorius and founds a truth cult to aid people and investigate mysteries.
timeline.quote: Centuries before the Phyrexian Invasion, the archon Ezrim broke off from the Azorius and founded a truth cult to aid people and investigate mysteries.

citation.text: "Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The reader learns Niv-Mizzet has taken over a Ninth District courtyard and had it sealed.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet has been doing something strange in a courtyard in the Ninth District.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: After Kos kills Momir Vig, the senate votes to place Ravnica under martial law under Augustin.
timeline.quote: they voted to place Ravnica under martial law under his guidance

citation.text: "Augustin IV", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Azorius Senate elects Leonos II as the new Grand Arbiter.
timeline.quote: the Azorius Senate elected Leonos II as the new Grand Arbiter

citation.text: "Augustin IV", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bori launched a viashino through the Harmony Basilica window and his Ossmorpher disintegrated the Veil Theatre.
timeline.quote: Bori launched a viashino through the priceless stained-glass window at the Harmony Basilica

citation.text: "Bori Andon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As the guilds struggle with their duties, independent detective agencies gain prominence and the guilds grudgingly accept their help.
timeline.quote: they were forced to grudgingly accept assistance

citation.text: "Detective", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ferzhin challenges the Azorius officials in guild talks on defending Ravnica.
timeline.quote: She challenged the Azorius officials, emphasizing the Legion's role in maintaining justice.

citation.text: "Ferzhin", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
